workstreams.title: Fix tasks marked complete whose claims did not match the code

items.change: Added POST /api/agent/:id/pause and /resume, backed by new WorkOrchestrator.pause()/resume() and a PAUSED work-item status; running work pauses at the next step boundary. The UI now reports refused pause/resume requests.
Cancelled work was still verified and marked completed; it is now reported as cancelled.
Added DELETE /api/pipelines/executions/:id; maps the API run ID to the executor's run ID and stops the run before its next stage.

Added the four example plugins (custom-analyzer, custom-reporter, slack-notification, custom-fix-strategy) and examples/plugins/README.md. The Slack example prepares a payload only, because plugins have no network access.

items.task: Existing no-todo-rule example and plugin guide
items.change: Fixed the rule's check signature to (filePath, ast, context); it previously searched the file path for TODO.
Updated openapi.yaml, /api/info, and the capability catalog for the three new endpoints.
Added test/__tests__/agent-pipeline-controls.test.js and test/__tests__/example-plugins.test.js.
Update P11-T004, P11-T005, P11-T019, and P11-T056 notes to reflect the actual implementation.
